name: Castor & Pollux II
source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wntrblm/Castor_and_Pollux/main/user_guide/docs/index.md (Winterbloom C&P user guide) ; https://www.perfectcircuit.com/winterbloom-castor-pollux-ii.html; ModularGrid panel image (checked 21 Oct 2026) (jack count matches)
notes: Jacks are on the bottom edge of the panel and largely marked with symbols, so labels here are descriptive (manual names). Pitch CV inputs 0-6V (1V/oct); POLLUX PITCH is normalled to Castor's pitch. PW = pulse width CV inputs (summed with knob in LFO PWM mode). CASTOR/POLLUX OUT are each oscillator's waveform-mix output (star symbol); MIX OUT is the crossfader combined output (Gemini symbol). Spec: 9 outputs total including the 6 on the 2HP expander.
